content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working on communicating with a [product_name] ([article_no]) via Ethernet, using VB.NET code as discussed in this thread to meet a customer's requirement for monitoring and reading IO values. Based on the [product_name] manual, I updated the port in the .NET code from 10001 to 8443 and successfully established a connection to the PLC, including connect/disconnect. However, functions like GetPLCStatus and running/stopping the PLC are not working, and I'm getting the following error message: "Error: Read Time Out. Detail Error Code : DTx0108L01". Following replies in this thread, I made these changes to the code: - Increased the send/receive timeout to 200000 ms, but the same error persists. - Synced the time between the PC and PLC. - Enabled permissions for S7 access and Modbus access in the [product_name] V8.3.0 offline settings. Could someone provide assistance with this? Thank you for your help. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from Logo - PC Communication programming Using Visual Studio.NET

While basic connection is possible after adjusting the communication port, essential functions such as status reading and run/stop control are failing due to read timeout errors. The user has already tried increasing timeouts, syncing system times, and enabling relevant protocol access in [product_name] V8.3.0 settings, but the main functionalities remain unavailable.
